snippet.title: Late Hours Trailer
snippet.description:
What's going on, YouTube! Sorry for my absence — I’ve been super busy. Here’s a small trailer for our upcoming game. I hope you enjoy it! Please wishlist and share your support if you can!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3743850/Late_Hours/?beta=0

Game Description:

Welcome to Late Hours, a psychological horror game set in a quiet burger joint… or so it seems.

You play as a late-shift worker trying to get through the night. Strange sounds, creepy events, and something watching you from the shadows.

🔪 Will you survive the night?
